deploy.verify: curl -f http://localhost:${OCTOP_PORT:-8088}/api/health (Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK; docker/README.md Health check); docker exec -it octop octop --version for the effective image; open http://localhost:8088 and complete first-boot admin login.
